subject: Post-demo: Governance & audit readiness — deployment path and runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Cho <sara.cho@medinova.health>, Tom O'Leary <tom.oleary@medinova.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Governance & audit readiness — deployment path and runbook

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock the deployment path for the pilot. Key outcomes from our call: 

- Primary security constraint: PHI throughput from Intake API must be routed to an environment covered by a signed BAA.
- Risk appetite: your security team prefers customer-managed VPC where logs and key management remain within MediNova, but the procurement team asked for predictable pricing and an SLA for throughput.
- Timeline ask: you need a compliance evidence package for your audit board by 2028-08-01.

Given that, I propose a two-track plan:

1) Short-term pilot (2–4 weeks): Hosted API with dedicated capacity (team-isolated pool) + prescriptive config to minimize PHI surface (token redaction + strict retention TTL). This gives the fastest time-to-live and lets us start performance validation.

2) Compliance-final deployment (target by end of Q3): Private VPC deployment (control plane in Redwood, data plane in your VPC) or pure on-prem if required — both options are compatible with a BAA and KMS/HSM-managed keys.

Action items I’ll own:
- Share a concise evidence packet (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS notes, data retention controls) by tomorrow.
- Draft a deployment-runbook that maps the pilot -> private deploy path and highlights the minimal engineering changes on your side.

Can you confirm which of these is acceptable for the audit board timeline and whether your security team can accept a Private VPC (Redwood-managed control plane, data stays in your VPC) versus fully on-prem?

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary-2027.pdf (summary), deployment-runbook-draft.md (draft).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sara Cho <sara.cho@medinova.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom O'Leary <tom.oleary@medinova.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Governance & audit readiness — deployment path and runbook

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side after I spoke with InfoSec: 

- Audit timeline is firm: we must present evidence to the compliance board on 2028-08-01. The board will accept a Hosted + contractual BAA only if we can show that all PHI is stored in an environment we control or under our KMS.
- Preferred route is Private VPC (control plane optional) because that keeps logs and disk encryption keys under our tenancy. On-prem is a last resort due to lead time.
- Procurement is worried about cost predictability; they asked for a defined monthly commit for dedicated capacity if we go with hosted/dedicated.

Open questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide a BAA that explicitly covers Private VPC (control plane hosted by Redwood but data/keys in our account)?
2) For the pilot on hosted/dedicated, can you confirm retention TTL and that we can disable text logging of raw prompts?

If you can get the evidence packet and a short runbook with these specifics by EOD Monday 2028-07-15, we can move this to the internal track and schedule a security sync the same week.

Regards,
Sara Cho
Director, Product & Security Liaison
MediNova Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Cho <sara.cho@medinova.health>, Tom O'Leary <tom.oleary@medinova.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Governance & audit readiness — deployment path and runbook

Hi Sara —

Thanks — attaching the evidence packet and an annotated runbook draft (Drive link below). Quick answers inline: 

1) BAA: Yes — Redwood can execute a BAA that covers Private VPC deployments where customer-managed KMS/HSM is used. Legal will add minimal language about access controls and data processing scope. We will loop Legal once you indicate intent.

2) Pilot controls on Hosted/Dedicated:
   - Retention TTL: configurable per-customer; we can set default 0-day persistent storage for prompts and token artifacts (i.e., ephemeral KV cache) and provide logs only for usage/metrics (aggregated).
   - Raw prompt logging: can be disabled. We support a redact-at-ingest policy and masked logging for debugging with your opt-in.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2-Summary-2027.pdf, BAA-template-annotated.docx, deployment-runbook-draft.md. Drive runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/drive/MN-Materials/runbook-draft

Proposed immediate steps (please confirm):
- You confirm Private VPC is preferred; I’ll route to Legal and Solutions to draft the SOW and BAA addendum.
- If you want a faster proof-of-concept, we stand up a dedicated capacity slice under a months-long commit and apply the TTL/redaction config. That path requires a two-week ops setup.
- Security sync: Wed 2028-07-17 10:00 AM PT — you in?

I’ll book the security sync once I hear back and share the DocuSign BAA link for signatures when Legal has the final.

Best,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Legal/PS handoff for MediNova (prep for Wed sync)

Jordan / Ben —

Following Jordan's send to MediNova, I need the following before I loop Legal and Solutions: 

- One-page summary for Legal: bullet list of the BAA points we must confirm (KMS boundary, log access, subprocessor list, incident notification SLA).
- Solutions: an ops checklist for Private VPC cutover (estimated tasks + owners + time). I want the two-week plan and the 1–2 month long plan separated.

Jordan — I copied Sara's deadline into the deal timeline (HubSpot DEAL-MN-2028-042). Please drop the one-pager and checklist into the Drive folder and ping me when ready; I’ll then open the Legal ticket and schedule the SOW draft.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
